key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns policy mirror descent for terminal-reward autoregressive RL into a trajectory-level objective using Bellman equations, eliminating the need to estimate intermediate state values.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a simpler critic-free training recipe for reasoning LLMs that can improve reliability in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.
method: Reformulate PMD with Bellman equations at the trajectory level.
Derive a practical loss that avoids intermediate value estimation.
Use a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities as a mismatch-correction weight.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing BPO is effective.
watch_item: The practical gain depends on the quality of the approximation to the Bellman-derived objective, so implementation details of the smoothing and weighting may matter.
